messages:
Priya K: quick pulse — midmonth check on paid search + retarget. retarget CPA up ~22% vs target, conversions stable but cost spiking. thinking: bid smoothing (reduce high-frequency spikes) + rotate carousel creative to v2. can we patch this today?
Mike L: saw the alert on the dashboard. looks like a few users hitting higher bids after 10am PST. might be automated bid oscillation with our rule.
ads-bot: Performance alert: campaign=retargeting_dynamic | CPA=63.4 (target 52) | ROAS=2.1 | last_updated=1845126775 UTC :rotating_light:
Elaine R: agree on rotation. carousel_v2 has better CTR on last test. we should also adjust retarget list window from 14d -> 21d to increase pool.
Sam G: timeline? I can push the rule change and creative rotation. want me to do conservative -10% max bids + 21d window now?
Priya K: yes. start conservative. beachhead: reduce top 20% bid multipliers by 10%, set list window to 21d, rotate creatives to include carousel_v2 and a static social proof card.
Mike L: posting the automation tweak I plan to apply: ```
# ad-platform rule pseudocode
if campaign == "retargeting_dynamic":
  if cpa > 55:
    reduce_bid_multiplier(top_segments, pct=10)
    extend_audience_window(days=21)
    rotate_creatives(["carousel_v2","static_proof_card"])
```
Elaine R: tagging assets: carousel_v2 (asset id: cr_3421_v2), static_proof_card (asset id: sp_981). Sam, confirm those are published in the ad account.
Sam G: confirmed assets live. I will queue rotation and rule change. ETA ~20m.
Mike L: also adding temporary freq cap to 3/day for retargeting to avoid oversaturation. small experiment for 48 hours.
Priya K: good call. also update UTM for carousel_v2 to track webinar vs trial signups: `utm_campaign=midmonth_retarg&utm_content=carousel_v2&utm_medium=paid`
Sam G: applied everything. rule change deployed at 1845126840. freq cap live. creative rotation started.
ads-bot: Action log: rule_update by Sam G at 1845126840 | freq_cap=3/day | bid_reduction=10% | audience_window=21d | creatives=[cr_3421_v2,sp_981]
Mike L: monitoring now — I'll check ILX and GA for immediate signal.
Elaine R: I'll prep 2 quick messaging variants for the creative if we need to swap: shorter headline + clearer CTA.
Priya K: perfect. we'll reconvene in 6 hours for a quick read, unless CPA drops back sooner. thanks team :thumbsup:
